23958.overview:
Zynga Poker is a Texas Hold 'em Poker game that can be played on various social networks as well as the iPhone/iPod Touch.

In the game players can win virtual dollars by playing Texas Hold 'em Poker. The player can choose a table with the maximum stakes, blinds and number of players of his or her choice.

Each day the player is given some extra money, the amount - ranging from hundreds of dollars to a million - is determined by a lottery. The player always wins some money. So if the player wasted all money on the previous day he or she can always continue.

Players earn experience points for playing hands. Better plays are awarded with more experience points. After a certain number of experience points the player goes level up and earns a new title. The player can also earn achievements for things like special hands. Money can be spend to purchase gifts. Gifts can be given to anyone sitting at the table and are visible to all players.

With some hands the player will find a collectible. Collectibles form sets of five. Completing a set earns a reward consisting of a cash bonus, experience and a mystery gift.

Using social networks like Facebook, MySpace, Bebo, Tagged and MyYahoo the player can see how well his or her friends are doing. It's also possible to play on the iPhone. The iPhone and Facebook versions are interconnected as they use the same account.

A chatbox allows players to chat with everyone at the table. Other social elements include the ability to start cooperative challenges with friends and sending friends playing chips.

32797.overview: Zenonia 2: The Lost Memories is the sequel to Zenonia, an action role-playing game developed, created, and published by Gamevil for the iOS and Android. It was released on the App Store on March 29, 2010, on the Android Market on December 24, 2010, and on the Amazon Appstore in the first quarter of 2011.

207082.overview:
Leave the urban area behind and explore a dangerous open world packed with zombies, challenges and loot! Take the wheel of 4x4 off-roaders, Monster Trucks, Six Wheeled Gas-Guzzlers and climb the
highest mountains where no man has gone before! Deadly weapons await you in this post-apocalyptic open world off-road sandbox game.

Do what you please: explore massive landscapes, complete challenges, smash zombies, find secret locations, unlock and upgrade cars and weapons, it's up to you!

Features:
- 6 sandbox regions to explore, filled with zombies and fun!
- 12 vehicles to unlock and drive, each with unique abilities. Police car, fire truck, APC, monster truck and much more.
- Machine-gun, shotgun, rocket launcher, electric gun to unlock and use against the dead
- Many challenges to complete: checkpoint hunt, path finding, boss fight and much more!
- Find hidden treasure chests scattered around the world
- Find "explorer flags" sitting on the highest mountains
- Awesome power-ups to use to your advantage
- Various zombie types to fight
- Fun driving simulator model
- Moon map with low gravity fun!
- Open World design, drive freely anywhere

All-terrain vehicles are going to be your key tool to survival and progress, upgrade them to be more durable and fast!
Take control! Tackle the challenges laid before you as you choose!

219279.overview:
Zaptiye - Order of the Ottoman is a three-dimensional action game in which players will be able to control an agent of the Ottoman Empire, with whom they will have to face the bandits that are terrorizing a town. Luckily, we will have our pistol and our knives.

The control system of Zaptiye - Order of the Ottoman is simple, direct and intuitive. On the left side of the screen we will have the virtual movement crosshead, while on the right side we will have the action buttons. We will be able to jump, duck, change weapons, reload and, of course, shoot.

In Zaptiye - Order of the Ottoman we will have two different game modes: on the one hand, the adventure mode for one player, in which we will have to face bandits controlled by artificial intelligence; and on the other hand the multiplayer, in which we will face other players over the Internet.

Zaptiye - Order of the Ottoman is a fun action game with an original setting and good graphics. An entertaining title, thanks to which we will be able to put ourselves in the boots of a true Ottoman agent.

Now add mutations to that and you got a recipe for success. Combine zebras to evolve them and discover their most curious, exotic and bizarre forms!

After Cow, Platypus, Goat and Giraffe Evolution, comes the sequel that made us question if the game design team will ever come up with a new game idea.

But wait… There’s more!

Download Zebra Evolution and have fun!
